question: Bimbisara sent physician Jivaka to treat the king of which dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Avanti__**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bimbisara, the ancient Indian king, sent the physician Jivaka to treat the king of the **Avanti dynasty**.
 
• Jivaka was the personal physician of the Buddha and the Indian King Bimbisara.
 
 
• He lived in Rājagṛha, present-day Rajgir, in the 5th century BCE.
 
• Sometimes described as the "Medicine King", he figures prominently in legendary accounts in Asia as a model healer and is honoured as such by traditional healers in several Asian countries.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Pradyota dynasty, also called **prthivim bhoksyanti**, is an ancient Indian dynasty, which ruled over Avanti in present-day Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Prodyota had two sons, Gopala and Palaka.
 
• Pradyotas of Avanti won Magadha and ruled there for 138 years from 799-684 BCE.
